pokemonstudio.name: Pokemon Studio: Life from Code
pokemonstudio.truth: Life is not designed. It is grown, bred, released, and surprised by what it becomes. The studio is where you learn to let go.
pokemonstudio.qfep_connection: The studio IS the full QFEP loop made interactive. Growth is entropy change over time (φ). Breeding is boundary dissolution — two organisms become one that is neither. Release is the transition from controlled to wild. Evolution is the free energy principle in action — organisms that minimize surprise persist. The drag queen aesthetic emerges naturally: when boundaries dissolve, what remains is excess, expression, and infinite variety.
pokemonstudio.description: A breeding and evolution laboratory where players grow life from DNA seeds, cross-breed across kingdoms, and release specimens into a shared ecosystem. Trees, creatures, flowers, and fungi coexist, compete, and evolve. The Pokemon Studio teaches genetic algorithms, procedural generation, ecology, and the QFEP through hands-on experimentation with living code.
learning_objectives: DNA as parameterized design — continuous genes, not discrete categories
Growth interpolation — how organisms develop from seed to maturity
Crossover and mutation — the mechanics of genetic algorithms
Cross-kingdom hybridity — boundary dissolution in code
Population dynamics — predation, symbiosis, competition, pollination
Evolutionary selection — fitness, tournament selection, culling
Emergent behavior — what happens when you release designed organisms into the wild
content: PS_Seed_Lab: From Nothing, Potential — Generate random DNA seeds, see them expressed as trees, creatures, flowers, or fungi. Genotype vs phenotype.
PS_Growth_Chamber: Watch Time Work — Grow a specimen from seed to maturity with time-lapse control. DNA interpolation in action.
PS_Kingdom_Safari: Four Kingdoms — Spawn one of each kingdom, inspect DNA side by side. Same genome, four expressions.
PS_Breeding_Lab: Two Become One Become Many — Select parents, breed, see crossover and mutation. Genetic algorithms made tangible.
PS_Hybrid_Workshop: Boundaries Are Soft — Cross-kingdom breeding. Push body_type to fractional values. Hybrid decorations emerge.
PS_Release: Into the Wild — Release specimens through the gate into the ecosystem. First contact with natural selection.
PS_Evolution_Arena: Selection Pressure — Run evolution cycles manually. Adjust fitness functions. Watch populations shift.
PS_Ecosystem: The Living World — Full ecosystem sandbox. All kingdoms, all ecology rules. Watch life evolve over generations.
